description: This file defines the PrimaryKey class, representing a PRIMARY KEY constraint in Spark's SQL connector catalog. It includes properties for columns, enforcement, validation status, and reliance, along with methods for equality, hash code, and building instances.

classes.name: PrimaryKey
classes.description: Represents a PRIMARY KEY constraint with properties for columns, enforcement, validation status, and reliance, used for query optimization in Spark.

classes.name: PrimaryKey.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing PrimaryKey instances with specified properties.

methods.name: columns
methods.description: Returns the columns that comprise the primary key.

methods.name: definition
methods.description: Returns the string definition of the primary key constraint.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another PrimaryKey object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code for the PrimaryKey object.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns a new PrimaryKey instance.
